prompt: In a vibrant anime style illustration set inside a bustling fire station bay, ten distinct elements populate the scene. On the left, a firefighter in a yellow helmet stands tall with arms crossed confidently. Next to him, a bright red fire engine gleams under the overhead lights, its chrome bumper reflecting the surroundings. A small brown dog sits calmly on the polished concrete floor near the front tire of the truck, looking up attentively. In the center, a woman in blue overalls points firmly at a large digital clock mounted high on the wall, indicating the time. Beside her, a man in a red scarf looks at the same clock with a worried expression, his hands clasped tightly together. Leaning against the side of the fire engine is a shiny silver axe, resting securely against the metal panel. To the right, a young boy in a green shirt sits on a wooden bench, holding a toy fire truck in his lap. Standing next to the boy is an elderly man in a gray coat who is handing a folded newspaper to the child. Behind them, a tall ladder leans vertically against the back wall, reaching toward the ceiling beams. Hanging from a hook on the far right wall is a coiled black hose, ready for immediate use. The scene captures a moment of quiet anticipation before an alarm might sound. There is no smoke filling the air, keeping the visibility crisp and clear. There is no fire burning anywhere in the station, ensuring the atmosphere remains safe and controlled. The composition balances the mechanical weight of the vehicle with the human interactions scattered throughout the space.
